messages:
Avery: Quick thought: the rollout console needs a compact "why degraded" surface so engineers don't have to drill into logs. Minimal: code, bucket, policy.
Ravi: Agree. Three small badges in trace row: CODE / BUCKET / POLICY. Color by severity. :traffic_light:
Nina: Important: reason text must be enum'd. No freeform strings that could leak PII.
Sasha: Implementation sketch: runtime emits reason_code enum, router stamps policy_id, ingestion attaches snapshot_id and model_version. UI composes badges.
Avery: Badge tooltip shows a 1-line explanation + link "Explain" that opens a playback with request snapshot.
Ravi: UX detail: heatmap on the rollout page - x axis time, y axis reason_class, intensity = count. Clicking a cell filters traces.
Nina: Sampling/retention proposal we can start with: critical=100% retention 30d, high=50% 14d, medium=5% 7d, low=0.5% 3d. Also keep a 72h hot window of full traces for playback.
Sasha: + add tenant opt-out flag and an enterprise retention override in the policy. Must surface in admin settings.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy degrade-badges v1 to prod-canary at 1730000200 :rocket:
Ravi: Security question: do we return reason_code to customers in API responses? My take: only a short header `X-Redwood-Degraded: rate_limit` for hosted; full sentinel JSON stays in control plane.
Nina: +1 on header-only. Also add a scrubbed customer_id hash when showing "recent degraded by tenant" lists.
Avery: UI mapping example for badge colors and labels:
```
badge_map:
  RATE_LIMIT: { label: "Rate limit", color: "#f1c40f", severity: "low" }
  KVMISS: { label: "Cache miss", color: "#e67e22", severity: "medium" }
  OOM: { label: "OOM", color: "#e74c3c", severity: "high" }
  HARD_ERROR: { label: "Hard error", color: "#c0392b", severity: "critical" }
```
Ravi: We should expose a mini-API for the console to query recent sentinel counts per rollout id to power the heatmap (aggregate endpoint, no raw traces).
Sasha: I'll add the endpoint to the intake-service spec and mark it as internal-only.
Nina: Don't forget privacy review & legal signoff before enabling header exposure.
Avery: Action items: @Ravi build heatmap agg endpoint proto, @Sasha add sentinel fields to intake + sample logic, @Nina run privacy checklist, I'll mock a compact badge row. Meeting tomorrow 10am to sync.
